description:
Replication package for M. Orzechowski, R. G. Słota and J. Kitowski, When the Consumer Is an Agent: Execution-Grounded Service-Level Agreements, ICSOC 2026 (Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer).

It contains the per-trial recordings of the study; the scoring code, which regenerates every table and every number stated in the paper's text from the recordings with one command (make check, standard-library Python); the experiment harness with its configuration; and an offline test suite. See README.md.

The package is maintained on GitHub: https://github.com/groundnuty/icsoc-2026-replication-package. This record archives its release.
